summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc, a foreign private issuer, announcing a planned change of chairman. John Kelly will step down as chairman at the May 5, 2026 AGM, with July Ndlovu, an independent non-executive director, proposed as his successor. No specific deal terms, prices, or premiums are involved; this is a routine board succession event. There is no forced departure, activist campaign, or special situation triggering the filing. The announcement is part of an ordinary governance transition, with Kelly remaining on the board as a non-executive director to provide continuity. This filing is a standard current report on management changes that do not constitute a special situation under event-driven analysis.
